name: Wires Crossed
source:
Two secret agents were tailing a cold-blooded kidnapper who made their victims play death game and recorded their sufferings for fun. However, just when the agents found his hideout, they fell into his trap-!

The two agents who couldn't get along at all, now forced to work together and play the death game to survive...

[From [url=https://nisie.itch.io/wires-crossed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两名特工正在追踪一名冷血的绑架犯。此人强迫受害者参加死亡游戏，还将他们的痛苦录下来取乐。然而，就在特工们找到他的藏身处时，却落入了他的陷阱！

这两个原本水火不容的搭档，如今被迫联手，参与死亡游戏，只为活下去……

[摘自[url=https://nisie.itch.io/wires-crossed]itch.io[/url]]
